_about: PC progression profiles for the week sweep (docs/concepts/D1-combat-followup-and-progression.md 4.4, slice step 3: a reading, no tuning). Per profile, one entry per campaign week (season.json weeks: 6): the average spell rank of the reference player's rows (bolt and every line row of its composition) in that week. A whole number ranks every row at it; a .5 ranks alternate rows at the two whole ranks around it. 'untrained' never earns a rank; 'steady' follows the D1 4.3 target 'by week N the average spell rank is about N - 0.5' (week 1 cannot go below rank 1, week 6 is capped at rank 5). Stats and agility stay at the reference's defaults: no camp earns agility yet. Enemy level is the week (season.ts prepareBout). Read only by packages/core/scripts/week-census.ts. 'rivalHpLevels' (D1 6.9, read only by the opt-in lag-hp arms): per curve, one opponent-mage HP level per week, an integer 1..6 that picks progression.pc.json enemyLevels.hpMult (the createGames opponentMage level), never falling; each lag-hp arm pairs rivalProfiles.lag with one curve.
